action_support: All policies exclude rules whose conclusions are known and rejected actions until a new proved fact changes the state. Receiver replies with available-subset position; sender maps to original public rule.
communication: Sender has public candidate features. Receiver has shared model U, bias and scoring head. Header stores candidate count, rank and bit depth. Activations are packed into bytes; each chosen action reply uses uint16. Model, normalization and quantization scales are charged once as setup bytes.
independent_unit: generated source proof DAG root, conditional on one trained checkpoint
primary_contrast: rank4_4bit root solve fraction against full_rank_float32 at equal verifier budget
scope: Synthetic finite Horn proof routing; trained small public-feature scorer; observational engineering pilot
selection: All rank/bit arms are fixed and reported. Test metrics select no arm or hyperparameter.

split_roles.train: fit weights, input normalization and message scales
